required_positive_assertions: PARENT is an exact derived branch cohort, not a synthetic question key
CHILD is generated under PARENT and carries exact immediate-parent identity
GRANDCHILD is generated under CHILD at depth greater than one and carries exact immediate-parent identity
branch-conditioned Y-to-Z cotravel is evaluated on exact same respondents inside GRANDCHILD
recursive grandchild-conditioned cotravel differs from the unconditional Y-to-Z lookalike
forbidden_substitutions: question-level branch key for exact cohort membership
generic pairwise same-respondent association for branch-conditioned cotravel
pre-authoring a grandchild independently instead of consuming the discovered child
unordered opaque ancestry refs as a substitute for exact immediate-parent recursive lineage
private compiler reconstruction or caller guesswork as a public recursive handoff
